前几天遇到的都是连级冲锋，今天自从拿下阵地之后，对面一直在组织营级的战斗冲锋。炮弹在阵地上炸开，刘济民好几次被气浪拍倒在了战壕里，温热的泥土如雨般砸在他的脸上。
炮群的主力正在协助攻打迷迈山，对这边的支援有限，只能依靠团里的炮火支援。
“卫生员，我遭了！”
“快，卫生员，一班长被子弹打中了！”
“指导员，连长让你接替指挥！”
“指导员，敌人太多了，怎么办？”宋大根跑过来问道。
连长受伤，按理是副连长接替指挥，马贵生觉得宋大根太莽撞，于是指定了刘济民。
刘济民低头背靠在坑道里，问道：“还有多少人？”
宋大根急忙说道：“还剩下一百三十多人，边防部队补充来的战士伤亡较大。阵地施展不开，敌人的炮火太猛了！”
刘济民抬头看了一眼继续往上冲的越军，第一道防线的防守压力越来越大。真让刘济民指挥全连，他的心里也是直打鼓。
“老宋，你带一个排埋伏到一防侧翼，让一防的战士佯败撤回来。一防和二防坡度较大，待敌人立足未稳、继续冲击的时候，你从侧翼攻击。上面等你信号，你一旦动手，我们来个反冲锋，将狗日的给压下去，你觉得咋样？”
宋大根看了一眼摇摇欲坠的一防，吐了一口唾沫：“就这样整，我带三排去，我们从西边埋伏，一防的战士往东边撤！”
“好！”
宋大根带着三排往侧翼绕，走了一个排，正面防线的压力就更大了。越南人似乎是发现火力弱了，冲锋的声势更大了，前排的悍不畏死的往上冲。
十五分钟后，宋大根带领的三排就位，一防的一排见状立即边打边撤往东边。
二十分钟后，越南人占领了一防，他们不等在一防组织火力，就开始往二防冲。因为角度大，加上土都被炸松了，一个个爬得非常艰难。
忽然，东西两条火龙顺着一防的战壕冲了出来，防线里的越军顿时惨叫起来，疯狂地脱衣奔跑。可是这衣服怎么脱都脱不掉，最终只能在惨叫声中化作焦尸。
74式喷火枪的最大射程可以达到45米，两边一同开火，火龙在中间碰撞，场景非常壮观。
九连总共三具喷火器，山顶的另一具在攻击的瞬间也打了下去。
一时间，阵地上有不少越军带火乱窜，顺着山坡往下滚，这一滚又引燃了不少人。
“吹冲锋号！”

What we encountered in the past few days were company-level charges. Today, since taking the position, the opposite side has been organizing battalion-level combat charges. Artillery shells exploded on the position, and Liu Jimin was knocked down in the trench several times by the air waves, and warm soil hit his face like rain.
The main force of the artillery group is assisting in the attack on Mimai Mountain. The support here is limited and can only rely on the artillery support of the regiment.
"Hygienist, I'm in trouble!"
"Hurry, health worker, the first squad leader has been hit by a bullet!"
"Instructor, the company commander asked you to take over the command!"
"Instructor, there are too many enemies, what should we do?" Song Dagen ran over and asked.
When the company commander was injured, it was logical that the deputy company commander would take over the command. Ma Guisheng felt that Song Dagen was too reckless, so he appointed Liu Jimin.
Liu Jimin lowered his head and leaned back in the tunnel, asking: "How many people are there?"
Song Dagen said hurriedly: "There are still more than 130 people left, and the soldiers who have been supplemented by the border defense forces have suffered greater casualties. The position cannot be deployed, and the enemy's artillery fire is too fierce!"
Liu Jimin raised his head and glanced at the Vietnamese army that continued to charge upwards. The defensive pressure on the first line of defense was increasing. Liu Jimin was really asked to command the entire company, and his heart was pounding.
"Old Song, you lead a platoon to ambush on the flank of the first defense, and let the soldiers on the first defense pretend to be defeated and retreat. The slope between the first defense and the second defense is relatively large. When the enemy has not gained a stable footing and continues to attack, you attack from the flank. We are waiting for your signal from above. Once you take action, we will launch a countercharge and crush the enemy. What do you think?"
Song Dagen glanced at the crumbling first defense and spat: "That's it. I'll lead the third platoon, we will ambush from the west, and the soldiers of the first defense will withdraw to the east!"
"Okay!"
Song Dagen led three platoons around to the flanks. After moving one platoon away, the pressure on the frontal defense line was even greater. The Vietnamese seemed to find that their firepower was weak, and the momentum of the charge became louder. The brave men in the front row rushed up without fear of death.
Fifteen minutes later, the third platoon led by Song Dagen was in position. Upon seeing this, the first defensive platoon immediately retreated to the east while fighting.
Twenty minutes later, the Vietnamese occupied the first defense. They began to rush towards the second defense without waiting to organize firepower on the first defense. Because of the large angle and the fact that the soil had been blown loose, it was very difficult for everyone to climb.
Suddenly, two fire dragons, east and west, rushed out along the first defense trench. The Vietnamese troops in the defense line suddenly screamed, stripping off their clothes and running frantically. But he couldn't take off the clothes no matter how hard he tried, and he could only turn into a charred corpse amidst the screams.
The maximum range of the Type 74 flamethrower can reach 45 meters. When both sides fire together, the fire dragon collides in the middle. The scene is very spectacular.
The Ninth Company had a total of three flamethrowers, and another one on the top of the mountain was also hit at the moment of the attack.
For a time, there were many Vietnamese troops running around the position with fire, rolling down the hillside. This roll set many people on fire.
"Blow the charge!"
